item.text: I’ll inspect the test file and its nearby context, then summarize the module and concrete issues without changing anything.

The module provides small shop-order helpers: calculate line-item totals, apply two discount codes, compute an average, and format an order as receipt text.

Bugs:

- [orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-k5Iuel\test\orders.js:5) has an off-by-one loop: `i <= items.length` reaches `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`. Accessing `.price` throws for every array, including an empty one. It should be `i < items.length`.
- [orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-k5Iuel\test\orders.js:20) divides by zero for an empty item list (once `calcTotal` is fixed), producing `NaN`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the total by number of distinct line items, not total quantity. If “item price” means per unit, this is logically wrong for quantities greater than one.
